freeze.cache: NEW backing-hot/default-buffered-client case, not old client-hot contract. Same application O_RDONLY pread, same full client SHA preload then full physical-payload SHA preload each target, outside timing. Require physical payload range mincore exactly64MiB before AND after each timed sample, stable dev/inode/size/mtime/ctime. Record client residency without asserting equal internal caches. No flush, drop_caches, O_DIRECT, cache configuration change or retry on gate failure.
freeze.read_barrier: close; initial fdatasync+dirfsync outside read timing; not power-loss proof
freeze.replicas: Owner Home local single; Moose CREATE/KEEP* one VALID local physical copy
freeze.interface: FUSE/POSIX; B client and both physical backing directories on B ext4
freeze.latency_samples: 64/sample; sorted raw; pool320/target after excluding warmup
freeze.throughput_judge: median5 AFS rates / median5 Moose rates >=1.2
freeze.latency_judge: pooledAFS p95 / pooledMoose p95 <=0.8; both mandatory

freeze.client_policy: Product defaults: both Owner switches OFF, private-local cache selected by public runtime, Moose AUTO. FUSE client residency is a separately reported layer; different internal caching is implementation behavior, not matching client residency. No attribution of prior Owner mincore0 to direct_io.
freeze.physical_payload: Owner exact physical root-e1/read.bin offset0/64MiB; single local VALID Moose exactchunk file8192-byteprefix+64MiB payload verified fullSHA, payload offset8192. No presumed undocumented chunk-format generalization.
